messages.subject: Time recording reminder - May narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear fee earners,

Our records show unposted time for the period to 28 May. Please ensure all time is recorded and narratives completed by 12:00 on Monday 2 June so that the May bills can be raised on schedule. Partners, please review and approve draft bills in the WIP report by close on Tuesday.

Regards,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
